syllabus_source: UKSSSC master syllabus 2026-08-31, 2.8 उत्तराखण्ड का सामान्य ज्ञान
note: Facets follow each bullet's own commas. Named-scheme launch dates, panchayat statutory details, research-institute locations and census statistics were added after reading ~90 real PYQs — all recur heavily and none is spelled out at this granularity in the bullets. Leaves state a FIXED fact (a scheme's launch year, an institute's location) rather than a changing current value, so they stay durable — genuinely volatile items (latest officeholder, this year's ranking) are left for a future current-affairs pass, per bullet 4's own scope.
